starting_schema.legacy_key: CertificationKey::Measured.machine_profile_hash or the canonical hash of CertificationKey::Declared

ddl: CREATE TABLE cert_rows_rebuilt (row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, certification_class TEXT NOT NULL, assurance_class TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, key_hash TEXT NOT NULL, machine_profile_hash TEXT, revisioned_machine_profile_hash TEXT, profile_activation_epoch INTEGER, model_id TEXT, decode_fingerprint TEXT, remote_profile_hash TEXT, identity_revision TEXT, numeric_profile_id TEXT, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, certified_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, os_build TEXT NOT NULL, module_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, evidence_schema_revision TEXT, processing_fingerprint TEXT, runtime_config_digest TEXT, constraint_runtime_identities_json TEXT, constraint_runtime_identities_digest TEXT, worker_path_evidence_json TEXT, g_dec_manifest_revision TEXT, evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (certification_class <> 'measured_owned_decode' OR (revisioned_machine_profile_hash IS NOT NULL AND profile_activation_epoch > 0 AND model_id IS NOT NULL AND decode_fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND evidence_schema_revision IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (certification_class <> 'legacy_owned_decode' OR status <> 'certified'))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cert_rows_owned_decode_identity_v2 ON cert_rows_rebuilt (revisioned_machine_profile_hash, profile_activation_epoch, model_id, decode_fingerprint, evidence_schema_revision, constraint_runtime_identities_digest) WHERE certification_class = 'measured_owned_decode'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cert_rows_declared_identity_v1 ON cert_rows_rebuilt (key_hash, fingerprint) WHERE certification_class = 'declared'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cert_rows_remote_identity_v1 ON cert_rows_rebuilt (key_hash, fingerprint) WHERE certification_class = 'remote'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cert_rows_embedding_identity_v1 ON cert_rows_rebuilt (key_hash, fingerprint) WHERE certification_class = 'embedding'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cert_rows_rerank_identity_v1 ON cert_rows_rebuilt (key_hash, fingerprint) WHERE certification_class = 'rerank'
replacement_schema.old_conflict_target_removed_after: all replacement indexes have been created and duplicate queries have returned zero rows

row_classes.upsert_conflict_target: ON CONFLICT (revisioned_machine_profile_hash, profile_activation_epoch, model_id, decode_fingerprint, evidence_schema_revision, constraint_runtime_identities_digest) WHERE certification_class = 'measured_owned_decode'
row_classes.lookup: current revisioned hash + current positive epoch + model_id + decode_fingerprint + compatible evidence_schema_revision + byte-exact ordered constraint identity-set digest
row_classes.staleness: revisioned hash, epoch, processing fingerprint, runtime config, worker path, constrained identities, evidence schema, and exact G-DEC manifest revision
row_classes.legacy_rule: a row missing model_id, positive epoch, complete gates, or supported evidence_schema_revision is legacy and cannot admit until re-probed

row_classes.staleness: existing declared row staleness semantics; no owned-decode profile or epoch admission

row_classes.lookup: remote certification wrapper and direct cert_rows SQL inventory
row_classes.staleness: existing remote identity behavior; never owned admission

row_classes.lookup: embedding certification wrapper and direct cert_rows SQL inventory
row_classes.staleness: existing embedding behavior; no approval record and never owned admission

row_classes.lookup: rerank certification wrapper and direct cert_rows SQL inventory
row_classes.staleness: existing rerank behavior; no approval record and never owned admission

row_classes.legacy_rule: retain for audit; re-probe into measured_owned_decode rather than backfilling a guessed profile, epoch, model, or evidence revision

migration_order: classify every row with an explicit certification_class; do not infer class from nullable measured-decode columns
backfill only deterministic legacy values; leave unknown owned bindings null and mark legacy_owned_decode
copy rows and validate class-specific nullability and logical identities
run every duplicate query below and abort without selecting a winner when any row exists
create and validate every replacement partial index
replace cert_rows and matching read/write paths
remove the old shared conflict target only after replacement indexes validate
commit; rollback on any semantic or infrastructure failure

before fleet deployment, add the ordered identity-set digest key; the fresh table has no production measured rows, and any pre-release development rows without the digest remain nonmatchable until re-probed
